chunks: Amīr al-mu’minīn also said concerning the Khārijites:

key_terms.الْخَوَارِجِ: The Khawarij, a early Islamic sect known for their rebellion and distinct theological/political views.
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Peace be upon him, an honorific used for the Imams.

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about the Khawarij?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) issues a directive to refrain from immediate combat with the Khawarij, reflecting the historical context of the Battle of Nahrawan, where he prioritized distinguishing true rebels from those with valid ijtihad. This stance underscores the Shia principle of avoiding hasty excommunication (takfir) and emphasizes strategic patience in dealing with early Islamic dissenters.
